answer.says: Mr. Saxena, I have discharged the state's claim in full, save for that trifling sum you deem personal. I note that the occupation is 'irregular,' yet I stand here as a functionary of the state, however accidental. I shall return on Friday for the orders. Until then, the system will do without my presence.
answer.thought: The arithmetic is finished; the spirit, however, is not. I have paid the state back its own money, and it thanks me by keeping the receipt of my poverty. The hunger in my belly is a particular that the universal bureaucracy cannot digest. I will not stay to argue with the wall; I will go home and face the silence there.
